player_prompt.intro:
Ati Player {player_id} ta'a **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe** keessatti.
Kunnee kee akka **[macro  micro]** (lakkofsa lama 0-8) dhiyeessi:
• *macro*  = mini-bordii kamittii kee taphattu
• *micro* = mini-bordii keessaatti kuta kammittii kee taphattu
Fakkeenya `[7 8]` ➜ mallattoo kee mini-bordii 7, kuta 8 keessatti kaa'i, fi
morkataa kee mini-bordii 8 keessatti taphachuuf dirqi.

Ati `{symbol}` ta'a.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sochiin kun bifa [macro micro] lakkoofsa 0-8 qabuun ta'uu qaba.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Indiicessonni hundi 0 fi 8 gidduutti ta'uu qabu.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row ykn col range keessaa ba'e.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Manni hidhaa kun amma iyyuu qabamee jira.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Taphattuun kun boordii xiqqoo itti aanu irratti taphachuu qaba.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Boordiin maayikiroo kun duruma kan mo'ameedha.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} mini bordii {macro_idx} keessatti, kuta {micro_idx} (safuu {row}, kuti {col}) keessatti taphate. Player {opponent_id} amma mini bordii {nxt_txt} keessatti taphachu qaba.

outcome.win: Taphattuun {player_id} Ultimate Tic Tac Toe mo'atti!
